dedupe_keys.name: homogenized gridded dataset for drought and hydrometeorological modeling for the continental united states

description: Homogenized gridded dataset for drought and hydrometeorological modeling for the continental United States is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Robert Erhardt et al. We present a novel data set for drought in the continental US (CONUS) built to enable computationally efficient spatio-temporal statistical and probabilistic models of drought. We converted drought data obtained from the widely-used US Drought Monitor (USDM) from its native geo-referenced polygon format to a 0.5 degree regular grid. Coverage: national (US); published in 2024. Formats: CSV, Image. The data are held in Dryad and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 1588626370 bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC0-1.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
